findings.summary: No test pins the call that delivers #878, `results = await _cooldowns.AfterRoundAsync(results, cancellation.Token)`. The only tests that build a QuotaCooldowns are ASpentQuotaIsRememberedUntilItsResetTests and ACoolingRowStaysOutOfTheRoundTests, and S26–S29 write the file by hand. Deleting this line, or `RefusedWrite` → `_noticing.Offered(RefusalNotices.StorageRefusal(...))` in PanelService.cs:456, leaves the whole suite green.
findings.fix: Add one test that runs a round through PanelService or RoundEngine with a scripted spent refusal (for example codex 'You've hit your usage limit…') and asserts quota-cooldowns.json holds the key and the next ExcludedFrom names the row. Add one test that a refused write (the lock held past a short wait) appends a StorageNote `failure` notice through Noticing.

findings.summary: The Kimi half of S25 uses a hand-written KimiFake whose QuotaKeyOf returns "kimi" and whose ReadResetAsync answers Guess, so KimiRuntime's real overrides (KimiRuntime.cs:287-293) are never run. The comment's claim that they are 'pinned by t1' is false: no test calls KimiRuntime.QuotaKeyOf or KimiRuntime.ReadResetAsync, so deleting them keeps everything green. The same holds for CustomCodexRuntime.QuotaKeyOf → empty.
findings.fix: Use the real KimiRuntime (KimiMonthlyQuotaTests.cs:91 already builds one) in S25. Add a CustomCodexRuntime assertion beside the DeepSeek one in ADeepseekRowParksNoCodexQuota_AndACodexRowStillParksIt.

findings.summary: S3's first case cannot go red for the plan's stated reason. Its reason carries 'Resets in 88h49m9s', so RetryLadder.ResetOutlasts makes it hopeless on its own: wired as `limited.Spent == true || ResetOutlasts(...)`, the case still sees 1 launch. The `?? RateLimit.Hopeless(reason)` half is not pinned by this case.
findings.fix: Use an undecided reason that is hopeless by its words and names no reset (for example 'You've hit your usage limit.'), and assert Launched == 1.

findings.summary: PlanAllAsync works through the keys in turn, and any OperationCanceledException from the agy probe throws away every plan made so far. A codex, Claude or Kimi park (no probe) or a lift decided in the same round is lost too. This happens whenever the round token has already fired, for example when the round's own deadline ended the round, which is the #878 situation. D5 only says a cancelled probe parks nothing.
findings.fix: Catch the cancellation per key in PlanAsync (that key gets no plan and the log says so), then apply the remaining plans in the one locked write.

findings.summary: StorageRefusal was inserted between Of's XML doc block and Of. StorageRefusal now carries two <summary> elements plus Of's long <remarks>, and Of has no documentation.
findings.fix: Move StorageRefusal (with its own summary) above Of's doc block, or below Of.

findings.summary: DeepseekRuntime.QuotaKeyOf has the same /// <summary> line twice.
findings.fix: Delete one of the two lines.

findings.summary: The S40 row '5h fraction is 2' can never fail. The weekly bucket is at 0.38, and a 5h bucket read as 2 is also > 0, so a reader without the [0, 1] range check still answers Available.
findings.fix: Put the weekly bucket at 0 in that row (or test the 5h bucket alone), so that reading 2 as a valid fraction changes the verdict.
